titleEn: YYDS: The Four Letters That Mean 'Eternal God' — China's Alphabet Slang
summaryEn: YYDS is the pinyin acronym of yongyuan de shen — 'eternal god', aka the GOAT. It marks China's alphabet-slang wave: acronyms escaping into speech.

symbolLayer.literalTranslation: 永远的神（拼音首字母缩写）
symbolLayer.explanation: 拼音首字母缩写（拼音缩写体）：永远的神 → YYDS；同类：xswl（笑死我了）/ nsdd（你说得对）/ zqsg（真情实感）
symbolLayer.explanationEn: Pinyin initialism (yongyuan de shen → YYDS); peers include xswl / nsdd / zqsg — keyboard-era shorthand reshaping spoken Chinese.

origin: 出自电竞直播圈（称赞选手「永远的神」），2020-2021 年破圈为全民最高级赞美词，2021 年被官媒点名「网络黑话」引发代际讨论
originEn: From esports streaming (calling players 'eternal gods'), it crossed over into everyday speech in 2020-2021 and drew official-media criticism of 'internet slang' in 2021.
usage: 万能最高级：「这火锅 yyds」；语气年轻且极度口语化，正式写作禁用；用法近似英文 lit/goat
usageEn: A universal superlative: 'this hotpot is yyds'; youthful, extremely colloquial, banned in formal writing; similar to English lit / GOAT.
commonMisreading: 不是随机字母组合，必须知道拼音才能解码——它是「拼音文化的暗号」，也是中文互联网代际沟壑的符号（看不懂=老了）
commonMisreadingEn: Not a random letter string — you need pinyin to decode it: a pinyin-culture password, and a symbol of the generational gap online.

memeLineage.event: 电竞直播圈将选手称为「永远的神」，缩写 yyds 出现
memeLineage.eventEn: Esports streamers call players 'eternal gods'; yyds emerges

memeLineage.event: 破圈为全民最高级赞美词，各平台刷屏
memeLineage.eventEn: Crosses over into a universal superlative; floods platforms

memeLineage.event: 官媒点名「网络黑话」，引发代际与语言规范讨论
memeLineage.eventEn: Official media flag 'internet slang'; generational and language-norm debate

memeLineage.event: TikTok 海外用户用 yyds 玩梗，「歪歪滴艾斯」语音化传播
memeLineage.eventEn: TikTok users play with yyds; the 'wai wai di ai si' voiced reading spreads

memeLineage.event: 定型为口语成分，与英语 GOAT 互译使用
memeLineage.eventEn: Settles into everyday speech, paired with English GOAT
